::: {#sol-root-step}

Since the condition is true, the body runs once and replaces `r` with $r' = r + 1$,
and then the condition is tested again.
At that next test,

$$
\ba
(r')^2
&= (r + 1)^2
\\&\le n,
&& \text{(the condition was true)}
\ea
$$

so $r^2 \le n$ is true again, for the new value of `r`.

:::
